The tournament at the White Sulphur Springs, In

yet to take place. The latter affair will take place

efforts are being made 10 finish the season there
with the usual brllliancy. The Hon. Abbott Law

court of Queen Victoria, in order to play his part

the same category, we find that distinguished
fashionable man, the Hon. John Minor Bolts, of
Virginia, and Prescott Hall, of this city, both of
whom are aiding and assisting the new American
Minister in getting up that splendid afar-the last
